description: What to wear (NWS hourly) — What to wear for a US location and time window, from the NWS hourly forecast: feels-like range (NWS wind chill / heat index), outfit (top, bottom), extras (umbrella vs hooded rain jacket when windy, waterproof boots for snow, sunglasses, sunscreen, water, gloves and hat, face covering) and tips, plus the hour-by-hour table. Params: lat and lon (or place=), optional date=YYYY-MM-DD (next ~6 days; default today, rolls to tomorrow if the window has passed), start= and end= local hours (default 8 to 18), activity=everyday|commute|walk|run|hike|bike|outdoor-work|kids|event (running dresses ~15F warmer). US only. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_what_to_wear
